from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class AccountsPayableRecord(BaseModel):
    """One company's Accounts Payable data point extracted from a single 10-Q document."""
    registrant_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name the financial statements belong to")
    line_item_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact label used for the line item in the document, e.g. 'Accounts Payable'")
    value: float | None = Field(description="The numerical value of Accounts Payable as reported")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The scale unit, e.g. 'thousands', 'dollars', 'millions'")
    reporting_date: str | None = Field(description="The date the financials are as of (e.g. 'March 31, 2024')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    accounts_payable_records: list[AccountsPayableRecord]
